preview: Today, we hear personal stories about husbands choosing their wives’ last names. The choice can bring different feelings within a family. What can help people talk about it when they do not all feel the same way?
comment_1: As you listen, notice what matters to the husband and the families when they discuss his family name.
comment_3: The same choice can feel very different to different people. What matters most to each person?
